scope: Exploratory old-data diagnostics only. No formal acceptance or new retrieval quality claim. Summary timings were observed in tool output; per-query timing samples were not retained for these rejected probes.

hidden_rank_streaming.method: Use the same weighted BM25 via rank MATCH, stream ORDER BY hidden rank until the complete rank tie at position 96, then sort by (rank,id) and truncate to 96.
hidden_rank_streaming.reason: Both candidate passes cost more total time; do not pursue an implementation based on this probe.

source_term_cache_simulation.accounting: sys.getsizeof(text)+sys.getsizeof(frozenset)+sum(sys.getsizeof(term))+128; LRU by full text, without storing queries/results.
source_term_cache_simulation.reason: At 512 entries only 7.11% of term calls would hit, under 1% of profiled total call cost before cache overhead; not worth a retained source-text cache.

project_rowid_bounds.decision: Do not add a cache; upper-bound benefit below 0.5% of complete recall.
